migration_flags.description: analytic_account_id field is ABSENT in v19 community purchase.order.line; replaced by analytic_distribution JSON field (from analytic.mixin). Migration must map single account ID to JSON dict e.g. {"<id>": 100.0}.

product_packaging_id and product_packaging_qty are referenced in purchase i18n files (en_AU.po:1695,1700) but are NOT defined in any Python source file of the community purchase module in v19. These fields appear absent from v19 community code.
taxes_id field was renamed to tax_ids in v19. The relation table is now account_tax_purchase_order_line_rel. Any scripts referencing taxes_id must be updated.
qty_to_invoice is forced to zero when order state is not 'purchase'. This affects any reporting or billing logic that reads this field on draft/cancelled orders.

qty_received_method has two possible values in base ('manual') and three with purchase_stock ('manual', 'stock_moves', False). Service products always use 'manual'; storable consumable products use 'stock_moves' when purchase_stock is installed.

key_findings.bill_control: purchase_method on product.template ('purchase'=on_order, 'receive'=on_delivery) controls whether qty_to_invoice is based on product_qty or qty_received; service products always default to 'purchase'
key_findings.qty_invoiced: Sum of linked account.move.line quantities (in_invoice adds, in_refund subtracts) via _prepare_qty_invoiced(); excludes cancelled moves
key_findings.qty_received: For service: manual field; for storable with purchase_stock: sum of done stock.move quantities on move_ids filtered by product_id
key_findings.date_planned: Computed as order.date_order + supplierinfo.delay days; falls back to today if no order date; stored and manually overridable
key_findings.analytic_distribution: JSON field from analytic.mixin; auto-populated from account.analytic.distribution.model rules; propagated to bill lines via _related_analytic_distribution()
key_findings.analytic_account_id: ABSENT in v19 — this is the single most critical migration flag
key_findings.prepare_account_move_line: Creates bill line dict with qty_to_invoice as quantity (negated for refunds), price_unit converted to bill currency, tax_ids, and purchase_line_id back-reference
key_findings.tax_ids_resolution: From product.supplier_taxes_id filtered by company then mapped through fiscal_position_id.map_tax()
